title: Seaclusion at Seagrove | KEY.co
description_expanded: The second level serves as the heart of the home, centered around an impressive chef’s kitchen featuring dual islands, premium appliances, and elegant custom finishes. The adjacent living area opens to expansive wraparound porches with breathtaking Gulf views, where floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors invite natural light and coastal breezes indoors. The upper level offers an elevated sense of privacy with multiple bedroom suites, many capturing stunning Gulf vistas, including a spectacular primary suite with vaulted ceilings and a spa-inspired bathroom designed to frame the water views. Complimentary beach setups, six adult bikes, and a six-seater golf cart make exploring the surrounding coastline effortless, creating a luxurious and unforgettable beachside escape. Perched along the Gulf with sweeping water views and private beach access, this newly constructed coastal retreat offers an extraordinary setting for gathering and relaxation. Thoughtfully designed across three spacious levels with elevator access, the home blends refined craftsmanship with effortless coastal living. The first level welcomes guests with a stylish entry and a spacious entertainment lounge complete with a custom bar, while a playful bunk suite and direct access to the courtyard create a perfect space for families. Outside, a private resort-style pool and spa anchor the beautifully designed outdoor living area, complemented by a summer kitchen ideal for open-air dining and evening gatherings.
